context: Sho visits Saito for a follow-up check.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: しょうくん、本当に、お元気そうで、安心。
lines.en: Sho-kun, you look wonderfully healthy. I'm so relieved.
lines.style: Warm, steady professional attention. A real smile underneath the words. Soft pace, unhurried—making room for the care she actually feels. The kind of doctor who slows down for the people she knows.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: おかげさまで、ちゃんと、頑張ってます。
lines.en: Thanks to everyone. I'm working hard, like I should be.
lines.style: Quiet, earnest pride. Small voice but steady. A six-year-old who takes being okay seriously. Slight lift at the end—he's doing it right and he knows it.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: お母さん、メイさん、ご家族、皆さん、お元気で。
lines.en: Your mother, Mei-san, your whole family—everyone's doing well?
lines.style: Gentle inquiry with real interest. Not checklist clinical, but genuinely asking about the people around him. Warm, unhurried. The small pause before 'everyone' lets the question breathe.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 皆、ひかりちゃんが、生まれて、すごく、嬉しい。
lines.en: Everyone's really happy since Hikari-chan was born.
lines.style: Bright with small-person joy. No performance—just genuine delight that spills out. The joy is in his voice more than the words. Soft and natural, like he can't help but share this.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: よかったね。ご家族、ずっと、繋がっていけて。
lines.en: I'm so glad. Your family stays connected through all of this.
lines.style: Closing warmth with quiet reflection. A gentle observation more than a statement. Slow, tender finish. The kind of thing an older person says when they've seen what matters.
